svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: cost per year of a budget dryer versus a premium dryer
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. A made-up budget dryer at 60 dollars replaced every year costs 60 dollars a year. A made-up premium dryer at 320 dollars kept eight years costs 40 dollars a year. Not a product test.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: cost per year
Not a shelf price and not a claim about how long a real tool lasts.
Budget: $60 replaced every year for four years is $240, or $60 a year.
Premium: $320 kept eight years is $40 a year. If it fails sooner, divide again.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. As of 29 Sep 2026.
